garrick_history.title: Garrick's History of the Grand Stenchmaster Sash
garrick_history.byline: <k>Claims by</> the Grand Stenchmaster. <k>Notes by</> the Captain.

entries.title: VERIFIED HISTORY
entries.claim: Everything below this line is the Grand Stenchmaster's claim. Nothing in it has been verified by anyone, ever.
entries.note: This is the only true entry. It's this one.

entries.title: The Sacred Stench
entries.claim: Since the dawn of time the Grand Stenchmasters have guarded THE SACRED STENCH. Six duties: eating, sleeping, resting, farting, ceremonial seat warming, sash preservation.
entries.note: Resting and sleeping are the same thing. He says resting is sleeping with your eyes open. Gristle did that all night. He didn't enjoy it.

entries.title: The Age of the Office
entries.claim: At least a thousand years. (Yesterday: centuries.) Tapestries: lost. Statues: destroyed. Written records: missing. Archaeological evidence: 'very private'.

entries.title: Princess Stenchalina the First
entries.claim: The first Grand Stenchmaster: an infant princess. The first Royal Waft shook the palace; her diaper and little royal trousers flew across the nursery; a yellow cloud; servants panicking. The disaster: her ceremonial ribbon FLUTTERED.
entries.note: He made this up this morning.

entries.title: The Sacred Sash Bearers
entries.claim: The royal council decreed that a Grand Stenchmaster's ceremonial fabric must never flap during a major Waft: two attendants hold the sash during a release.
entries.note: His own made-up history says it's a fart sash. (Pete.)

entries.title: The Five Grand Treasures
entries.claim: I. The Grand Crown ('reconstructed from historical descriptions'). II. The Sacred Seat. III. The Grand Eating Bowl. IV. The Stenchmaster Entertainment System ('spiritually'). V. The Grand Sash ('descended through generations').
entries.evidence: The crown was made yesterday out of Jim's forks. The seat is the galley chair. The bowl is Jim's mixing bowl. The television is a television.
entries.note: Jim wants his bowl back. Jim wants it back un-grand.

entries.title: The Grand Stenchmasters of Old
entries.claim: Sir Stenchalot the Flatulent. Lady Windbottom the Mighty. Grand Duke Gassius the Loud. Admiral Rumpus Thunderpants.
entries.evidence: The portraits all have his moustache

entries.title: The Battle of the Seven Winds
entries.claim: Admiral Thunderpants, in the Grand Sash, faced seven ships. His blast turned six of them round. The seventh sank from embarrassment.
entries.evidence: 'It went red. Then it went down.'
entries.note: Ships don't blush. (Ned, forty years at sea.)

entries.title: The Grand Stenchmaster Sash
entries.claim: Ancient. Descended through generations. A sacred ceremonial textile.
entries.evidence: A CLEARANCE sticker inside the hem. His own words, asleep: a sketchy discount shop; LAST WEEK; seventy per cent off; cash only; no refunds. Witnesses: Pete, Gristle, Bob, Squawks. No receipt.

variants.claim: Ancient. Descended through generations. (Revised: bought last week MATERIALLY; ancient SYMBOLICALLY; survived a thousand years EMOTIONALLY; previous owners: historical re-enactment.)
variants.note: NO RECEIPT. He's changing what words mean. Ned says he's changing what TIME means.

entries.title: What the Sash Is For
entries.claim: 'It's so somebody can hold it while I fart.' Later, in plain words: 'I want somebody to hold the sash so it doesn't flutter while I fart.'

entries.title: The Lost Fart (third attempt)
entries.claim: THE GRAND EXPEDITION FOR THE LOST FART: ancient ruins, ten thousand years, stench spirits.
entries.evidence: A discount store. Seven days. Bargain-bin employees.
entries.note: The hat is back in the trunk. I sat on the lid.

entries.title: The Sash Organisation
entries.claim: The Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Stenchmaster Sash's Grand Assistant (Bob: resigned in advance). The Grand Steward of the Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Sash. The Deputy Grand Sash Steward. The Acting Assistant Deputy Grand Steward of Stenchmaster Textiles. The Emergency Sash Technician. The Senior Flutter Observer (fifteen feet away, for safety). The Ceremonial Sash Herald (Squawks: no job).
entries.note: The only safe job is the one fifteen feet away from the job. (Ned.) I KNEW IT. (Bob.)

entries.title: Stenchmaster Excavation Technology
entries.claim: Stand over the hole and release: the sand goes elsewhere, the clay goes elsewhere, the rocks go VERY elsewhere. The treasure 'hopefully stays'.

variants.evidence: The treasure did not stay. The treasure went VERY elsewhere: up the column, into the Great Sharkstorm.
variants.note: 'Vertical relocation.' The treasure is no longer underground, he says. It's in the SKY.

entries.title: Crownskull Isle
entries.caption: The Crimson Chart: Crownskull Isle, and its X.
entries.where: A mile off the Revenge, on the map at last
entries.notes: Pale beach, reefs, jungle, a river, cliffs, ruins, and the ridge: a skull with a crown on. The island on my map. MY island.

variants.notes: Pale beach, reefs, jungle, a river with a ford, a broken tooth, a statue, ruins, a lagoon, a ridge like a crowned skull. Landed by Pete's plan, which was good. He's still furious about it.

entries.title: The Fortune of the Crimson Kings
entries.caption: The marker: THE FORTUNE OF THE CRIMSON KINGS.
entries.where: The Crimson Clearing, under the skull. Beneath seven floors.
entries.notes: Twelve royal gold crowns. Chests of doubloons. Rubies. Emerald necklaces. Silver bars. Pearls. Diamonds. The plate and sceptres of six kings. And the Crimson King's Crown.

variants.where: Up. In the storm. On the sharks.
variants.holder: The Great Sharkstorm; the sharks (pearls, chains, a tiara, rings); the crowned megalodon
variants.notes: Found. Dug. Exposed. Blown up a column of the Grand Stenchmaster's release into the Great Sharkstorm. Recovered: about two per cent, out of the crater, and it reeks. Known major object: the Crimson King's Crown. Current holder: THE CROWNED MEGALODON. We are going to get it ALL back.

entries.title: The Grand Sharkmaster
entries.caption: GRAND SHARKMASTER = PETE. (A copy. Pete tore up the first one.)
entries.notes: Appointed: Peg-Leg Pete. Accepted: No. Authority: None. Duties: apparently every shark problem Garrick doesn't want. Pete's note: 'I QUIT.' Garrick's note: 'Request denied.' (A title, not a job. Pete is still a deckhand.)

entries.title: The Blue Sash
entries.notes: The other half of the discount two-pack. Sky blue, GRAND SHARKMASTER painted on in white. Thrown on the floor, stuffed in the water barrel, dropped in the bilge. It keeps coming back.

entries.title: The Megalodon
entries.where: The lagoon on Crownskull Isle, west of the ruins
entries.notes: Thrown out of the Great Sharkstorm after the Grand Excavation. The biggest shark there has ever been. Too big for the lagoon; too stuck to leave.

variants.holder: The Crimson King's Crown (on its head)
variants.notes: Thrown out of the Great Sharkstorm after the Grand Excavation. Too big for the lagoon; too stuck to leave. The Crimson King's Crown fell out of the storm and landed on its head, crooked. A perfect fit. Squawks: 'Big shark king.' No.

entries.title: The Great Sharkstorm
entries.notes: Weaker than at its worst. Still turning. Still throwing sharks. It followed us all the way to the island. 'Strong scent.'

variants.where: Off the coast of Crownskull Isle
variants.notes: It came inland after the Grand Excavation, dropped great whites on the island, threw a megalodon into the lagoon, and swallowed the Crimson Fortune. Now it glitters. The sharks going round in it are wearing my treasure. One of them winked.

variants.where: Off Crownskull Isle's coast (the cliffs keep it out)
